<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="314" y1="22" x2="314" y2="27" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="19" x2="319" y2="27" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="16" x2="324" y2="27" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="13" x2="329" y2="27" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="22" x2="350" y2="22" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="360" y="15" width="24" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="363" y="18" width="17" height="7" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
    <rect x="384" y="19" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="27,62 38,51 49,62 49,78 27,78" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="27,62 38,51 49,62" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="60" y="72" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">contra</text>
    <g>
      <line x1="352" y1="55" x2="373" y2="76" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <line x1="373" y1="55" x2="352" y2="76" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="157" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="36px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="32" y="190" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Sign in to continue to your Contra account.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="238" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Email address</text>
    <rect x="32" y="250" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="285" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">alex.morgan@email.com</text>
    <circle cx="335" cy="278" r="9" fill="#00C6AE"/>
    <polyline points="330,278 334,282 341,274" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="336" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Password</text>
    <rect x="32" y="348" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="78" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="102" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="114" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="138" cy="376" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="335" cy="376" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#474A57" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="383" x2="348" y2="389" stroke="#474A57" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="376" x2="341" y2="376" stroke="#474A57" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Forgot password -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="435" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1947E5">Forgot password?</text>
    <line x1="32" y1="440" x2="143" y2="440" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="475" width="326" height="60" rx="16" fill="#18191F"/>
    <rect x="32" y="473" width="326" height="60" rx="16" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="510" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17px" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account prompt -->
  <g>
    <line x1="32" y1="573" x2="137" y2="573" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="578" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">New to Contra?</text>
    <line x1="253" y1="573" x2="358" y2="573" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="32" y="599" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="195" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Create an account</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Trust note -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="691" r="10" fill="#D6FCF7" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="43,691 47,695 54,687" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="67" y="696" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Your information is private and secure.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="754" x2="390" y2="754" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,781 50,772 61,781 61,795 39,795" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="39,781 50,772 61,781" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="50" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="128" cy="782" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="135" y1="789" x2="142" y2="796" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="128" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#474A57">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="193" y="775" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="199,791 202,797 207,791" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="200" cy="783" r="1.5" fill="#18191F"/>
      <circle cx="206" cy="783" r="1.5" fill="#18191F"/>
      <text x="204" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#474A57">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="294" cy="779" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="294" cy="794" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="294" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#474A57">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="356" cy="783" r="10" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="356" cy="783" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="356" y1="770" x2="356" y2="767" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="356" y1="799" x2="356" y2="796" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="343" y1="783" x2="340" y2="783" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="372" y1="783" x2="369" y2="783" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="356" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#474A57">Settings</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
